# Plotting

## UMAP and cell composition

```{r}
annotation_markers <-
  c("CD10", "CD117", "CD11a", "CD11b", 
    "CD11c", "CD123", "CD127", "CD138", "CD14", "CD141", "CD158", 
    "CD159a", "CD159c", "CD16", "CD19", "CD1c", "CD20", "CD24", "CD25", 
    "CD27", "CD28", "CD3e", "CD335", "CD337", "CD35", "CD38", 
    "CD4", "CD8", "CD45RA", "CD45RO", "CD56", "CD57", "CD58", "CD66b", "CD95", 
    "HLA-DR", "IgD", "TCRgd", "TCRva7.2", "TCRVd2", "TCRVg9", 
    "CD41", "CD9", 
    
    "TCRab", "CD45", "CD45RB", "CD2", "CD5", "CD26", "CD161", 
    "CD21", "CD22", "CD33", "CD79a", "CD7", "IgE", "IgM", "NKp80")

adata <- 
  anndata::read_h5ad("../data/BrodinLab_pixelgen_data_forpublication/h5ad_clustering_to_pixelgen/adata_counts_all_to_pixelgen.h5ad")


seur <- 
  CreateSeuratObject(t(adata$X)) %>% 
  NormalizeData(normalization.method = "CLR", margin = 2) |> 
  AddMetaData(metadata = read_csv("../data/BrodinLab_pixelgen_data_forpublication/h5ad_clustering_to_pixelgen/metadata_to_pixelgen.csv") %>% 
                column_to_rownames("component"))

set.seed(37)
seur <- 
  seur |> 
  NormalizeData(normalization.method = "CLR", margin = 2) %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 75) %>%
  ScaleData() 

VariableFeatures(seur)[!VariableFeatures(seur) %in% annotation_markers]

seur <- 
  seur %>% 
  RunPCA(features = annotation_markers) %>%
  RunHarmony(
          group.by.vars = "sample",
          plot_convergence = FALSE,
        ) |> 
  RunUMAP(reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:15, n.neighbors = 15, seed.use = 38) |> 
  FindNeighbors(reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:15, k.param = 15) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.5, random.seed = 37)


seur[[]] |> 
  group_by(sample) |> 
  mutate(rank = rank(-n_umi)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(rank, n_umi)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1e4) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_x_log10()

Reductions(seur, "pca")@stdev %>% 
  enframe("PC", "sd") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(PC, sd)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point()
#   
# seur <- 
#   seur %>% 
#   FindNeighbors(reduction = "pca", dims = 1:15, k.param = 15) 

plot_embedding(seur, "umap",
               metavars = "condition",
               # pal = cell_palette,
               plot_title = "Clusters")

plot_embedding(seur, "umap",
               metavars = "CellType",
               pal = pbmc_cell_type_palette,
               plot_title = "samples") 

plot_embedding(seur, "umap",
               metavars = "seurat_clusters",
               plot_title = "samples") 


plot_data <- 
  seur %>% 
  Embeddings("umap") %>% 
  as_tibble(rownames = "component") %>% 
  left_join(FetchData(seur, c("sample", "condition", "CellType")) %>% 
              as_tibble(rownames = "component"))


plot_data %>% 
  ggplot(aes(umap_1, umap_2, color = CellType)) +
  # geom_path() +
  geom_point(size = 0.3) +
  geom_text(data = . %>% 
              group_by(CellType) %>%
              summarise(umap_1 = median(umap_1),
                        umap_2 = median(umap_2)),
            aes(label = CellType), 
            color = "black",
            size = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pbmc_cell_type_palette) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank()) +
  labs(color = "Cell type",
       x = "UMAP 1",
       y = "UMAP 2") 

ggsave(
  filename = "../results/Brodin/UMAP_annotated_cells.pdf",
  width = 8,
  height = 8
)
ggsave(
  filename = "../results/Brodin/UMAP_annotated_cells_small.pdf",
  width = 5,
  height = 5
)

plot_data %>% 
  write_csv("../results/Brodin/Fig5A_data.csv")

plot_data %>% 
  ggplot(aes(umap_1, umap_2, color = condition)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("SLE" = "#E67C81", "HC" = "gray70")) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank()) +
  labs(color = "Cell type",
       x = "UMAP 1",
       y = "UMAP 2") 

ggsave(
  filename = "../results/Brodin/UMAP_sle.pdf",
  width = 8,
  height = 8
)
ggsave(
  filename = "../results/Brodin/UMAP_sle_small.pdf",
  width = 5,
  height = 5
)

seur[[]] |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  group_by(sample, condition, CellType) |> 
  count() |> 
  group_by(sample) |> 
  mutate(frac = n / sum(n)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(CellType = factor(CellType, names(pbmc_cell_type_palette))) |> 
  ggplot(aes(sample, frac, fill = CellType)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(100*frac, 1), "%")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5)) +
  facet_grid(~ condition, scales = "free_x", space = "free") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pbmc_cell_type_palette) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = expansion(0)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank()
    )
ggsave(
  filename = "../results/Brodin/cell_type_composition.pdf",
  width = 4,
  height = 5
)

seur[[]] |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  group_by(sample, condition, CellType) |> 
  count() |> 
  group_by(sample) |> 
  mutate(frac = n / sum(n)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(CellType = factor(CellType, names(pbmc_cell_type_palette))) %>% 
  write_csv("../results/Brodin/Fig5B_data.csv")
```

#### Proximity Analysis

```{r}

prox <- read_csv("../data/BrodinLab_pixelgen_data_forpublication/h5ad_clustering_to_pixelgen/B_clustering.csv") |> 
  left_join(FetchData(seur, c("condition", "CellType", "n_umi")) |> 
              as_tibble(rownames = "component")) |> 
  mutate(p1 = marker_1_count / n_umi,
         p2 = marker_2_count / n_umi,
         pmin = ifelse(p1 < p2, p1, p2))


table(unique(prox$component) %in% colnames(seur))
n_distinct(prox$component)
# prox$component
prox$sample |> table()
prox$CellType |> table()

prox |> 
  mutate(type = ifelse(marker_1 == marker_2, "self", "cross")) |>
  ggplot(aes(pmin, fill = type)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0.001)) +
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.5, 
                 position = position_dodge()) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(x = "Minimum marker frequency") +
  theme_bw() 

prox_sum <- 
  prox |> 
  filter(pmin > 0.001) |> 
  SummarizeProximityScores(group_vars = "condition") 


plot_markers <- 
  seur |> 
  subset(CellType == "B") |> 
  LayerData("data") |> 
  rowSums() |> 
  sort() |> 
  tail(20) |> 
  names()

plot_markers <- unique(c(plot_markers, "CD21", "CD180", "CD19", "CD81"))

plots <- 
  prox_sum$condition |> 
  unique() |> 
  set_names() |> 
  lapply(function(cond) {
    prox_sum |> 
      filter(condition == cond) |>
      filter(marker_1 %in% plot_markers,
             marker_2 %in% plot_markers) |> 
      mutate(mean_log2_ratio = ifelse(abs(mean_log2_ratio) > 0.75, sign(mean_log2_ratio) * 0.75, mean_log2_ratio)) |> 
      ColocalizationHeatmap(value_col = "mean_log2_ratio", 
                            size_col = "pct_detected", 
                            size_range = c(4, 4),
                            colors = pixelatorR::PixelgenGradient(100, "BluesCherry"),
                            type = "dots") +
      coord_fixed() +
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
      labs(title = cond)
    
  })

pdf(
  file = "../results/Brodin/B_cell_proximity_heatmap.pdf",
  width = 6,
  height = 5
)
plots
dev.off()


prox_sum |> 
  filter(condition == "SLE") |>
  filter(marker_1 %in% plot_markers,
         marker_2 %in% plot_markers) |> 
  mutate(mean_log2_ratio = ifelse(abs(mean_log2_ratio) > 0.75, sign(mean_log2_ratio) * 0.75, mean_log2_ratio)) %>% 
  select(marker_1, marker_2, mean_log2_ratio) %>% 
  write_csv("../results/Brodin/Fig5C_data.csv")
                          
p1 <- 
  prox_sum |> 
  filter(condition == "SLE") |>
  filter(marker_1 %in% plot_markers,
         marker_2 %in% plot_markers) |> 
  mutate(mean_log2_ratio = ifelse(abs(mean_log2_ratio) > 0.8, sign(mean_log2_ratio) * 0.8, mean_log2_ratio)) |> 
  ColocalizationHeatmap(value_col = "mean_log2_ratio", 
                        size_col = "pct_detected", 
                        size_range = c(4, 4),
                        colors = pixelatorR::PixelgenGradient(100, "BluesCherry"),
                        type = "dots") +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  labs(title = "SLE")

p2 <- 
  prox_sum |> 
  filter(condition == "HC") |>
  filter(marker_1 %in% plot_markers,
         marker_2 %in% plot_markers) |> 
  mutate(marker_1 = factor(marker_1, levels(p1@data$marker_1)),
         marker_2 = factor(marker_2, levels(p1@data$marker_2))) |>
  mutate(mean_log2_ratio = ifelse(abs(mean_log2_ratio) > 0.8, sign(mean_log2_ratio) * 0.8, mean_log2_ratio)) |> 
  ColocalizationHeatmap(value_col = "mean_log2_ratio", 
                        size_col = "pct_detected", 
                        cluster_cols = FALSE,
                        cluster_rows = FALSE,
                        size_range = c(4, 4),
                        colors = pixelatorR::PixelgenGradient(100, "BluesCherry"),
                        type = "dots") +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  labs(title = "HC")

p2 | p1

ggsave(
  filename = "../results/Brodin/B_cell_proximity_heatmap_sidebyside.pdf",
  width = 12,
  height = 5
)

p3 <- 
  prox_sum |> 
  filter(marker_1 %in% plot_markers,
         marker_2 %in% plot_markers) |> 
  mutate(marker_1 = factor(marker_1, levels(p1@data$marker_1)),
         marker_2 = factor(marker_2, levels(p1@data$marker_2))) |>
  select(condition, marker_1, marker_2, mean_log2_ratio) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = mean_log2_ratio) |>
  mutate(diff = SLE - HC) |> 
  mutate(diff = ifelse(abs(diff) > 0.5, sign(diff) * 0.5, diff)) |>
  ColocalizationHeatmap(value_col = "diff", 
                        size_col = "diff", 
                        cluster_cols = FALSE,
                        cluster_rows = FALSE,
                        size_range = c(4, 4),
                        colors = pixelatorR::PixelgenGradient(100, "BluesCherry"),
                        type = "dots") +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  labs(title = "SLE - HC")

p3
ggsave(
  filename = "../results/Brodin/B_cell_proximity_heatmap_difference.pdf",
  width = 6,
  height = 5
)

diff_prox <- 
  prox |> 
  filter(pmin > 0.0025) |>
  DifferentialProximityAnalysis(
    proximity_metric = "log2_ratio",
    backed = "data.table",
    min_n_obs = 10,
    contrast_column = "condition",
    reference = "HC")

diff_prox |> 
  ggplot(aes(diff_median, -log10(p_adj))) +
  geom_point(size = 0.1) +
  geom_text(
    data = . %>% 
      filter(p_adj < 0.05,
             abs(diff_median) > 0.25),
    aes(label = paste0(marker_1, "/", marker_2)),
    vjust = 1.5, size = 3
  ) +
  theme_bw()
ggsave(
  filename = "../results/Brodin/B_cell_proximity_differential_proximity_volcano.pdf",
  width = 6,
  height = 5
)



some_markers <- 
  diff_prox |> 
  filter(p_adj < 0.001,
         diff_median > 0.25) |> 
  select(marker_1, marker_2) |> 
  unlist() |> 
  unique()

FetchData(seur, c("condition", "sample", "CellType", some_markers)) |> 
  as_tibble(rownames = "component") |> 
  filter(CellType == "B") |> 
  pivot_longer(-c(component, condition, sample, CellType), names_to = "marker", values_to = "clr") |>
  ggplot(aes(condition, clr, group = sample, fill = condition))+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_violin(aes(group = sample), draw_quantiles = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(aes(group = sample), 
              position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.85, jitter.width = 0.1),
              size = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_compare_means(
    # aes(label = ..p.format..), 
    comparisons = list(c("HC", "SLE")),
    method = "wilcox.test", 
    size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~marker, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0.05, 0.2))) + 
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "CLR",
       title = "Marker expression by condition") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("SLE" = "#E67C81", "HC" = "gray70"))

FetchData(seur, c("condition", "sample", "CellType", some_markers)) |> 
  as_tibble(rownames = "component") |> 
  filter(CellType == "B") |> 
  pivot_longer(-c(component, condition, sample, CellType), names_to = "marker", values_to = "clr") |> 
  left_join(prox |> 
              filter(marker_1 %in% some_markers,
                     marker_2 %in% some_markers, 
                     marker_1 == marker_2) |> 
              filter(pmin > 0.001) |> 
              select(component, marker = marker_1, log2_ratio)) |> 
  pivot_longer(c(clr, log2_ratio), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(value = ifelse(is.na(value), 0, value)) |>
  ggplot(aes(condition, value, group = sample, fill = condition))+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_violin(aes(group = sample), draw_quantiles = 0.5) +
  ggbeeswarm::geom_beeswarm(aes(group = sample),
                            dodge.width = 0.9,
                            corral.width = 0.45, 
                            size = 0.1) +
  stat_compare_means(
    # aes(label = ..p.format..), 
    comparisons = list(c("HC", "SLE")),
    method = "wilcox.test", 
    size = 3) +
  facet_grid(metric~marker, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0.05, 0.2))) + 
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Value") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("SLE" = "#E67C81", "HC" = "gray70"))

ggsave(
  filename = "../results/Brodin/B_cell_marker_expression_and_proximity_by_condition.pdf",
  width = 18,
  height = 5
)

plot_data_test <- 
  FetchData(seur, c("condition", "sample", "CellType", c("CD180", "CD21"))) |> 
  as_tibble(rownames = "component") |> 
  filter(CellType == "B") |> 
  pivot_longer(-c(component, condition, sample, CellType), names_to = "marker", values_to = "clr") |> 
  left_join(prox |> 
              filter(marker_1 %in% c("CD180", "CD21"),
                     marker_2 %in% c("CD180", "CD21"), 
                     marker_1 == marker_2) |> 
              filter(pmin > 0.001) |> 
              select(component, marker = marker_1, log2_ratio)) |> 
  pivot_longer(c(clr, log2_ratio), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(value = ifelse(is.na(value), 0, value)) 

library(rstatix)
stat.test <- 
  plot_data_test %>%
  group_by(marker, metric) %>%
  wilcox_test(value ~ condition) %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "condition")

# 2. View exact unadjusted p-value in console
print(stat.test$p)

plot_data_test |>
  ggplot(aes(condition, value, group = sample, fill = condition))+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_violin(aes(group = sample), draw_quantiles = 0.5) +
  ggbeeswarm::geom_beeswarm(aes(group = sample),
                            dodge.width = 0.9,
                            corral.width = 0.45, 
                            size = 0.1) +
  # stat_compare_means(
  #   # aes(label = ..p.format..), 
  #   comparisons = list(c("HC", "SLE")),
  #   method = "wilcox.test", 
  #   size = 3) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat.test, 
    label = "p = {p}", # Or label = "p = {format.pval(p, digits = 3)}"
    size = 3
  ) +
  facet_grid(marker~metric, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0.05, 0.2))) + 
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Value") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("SLE" = "#E67C81", "HC" = "gray70")) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

ggsave(
  filename = "../results/Brodin/B_cell_marker_expression_and_proximity_by_condition_selected.pdf",
  width = 6,
  height = 6
)



plot_data %>% 
  write_csv("../results/Brodin/Fig5DE_data.csv")
```
